## Scope

State the boundaries and important exclusions. Link shared requirements or

## Work items

<!--
Link actual child issues and give each a short outcome description.

Do not open extra issues merely to populate this section. When decomposition

## Completion criteria

State when the parent can close, including any necessary integration check.
Account for each required outcome: delivered, explicitly deferred, or rejected

-->
